[[File:Rebel_Elite_Commando.jpg|thumb|200px|A Rebel Elite Commando.]]
The '''elite commandos''' at the [[Battle of Restuss]] were the best-trained troops the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had available to them, and were used to lead troops into battle and protect [[Vrinko|officers]]. They were specially trained by Imperial defectors to fight and counter [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, both on the ground and in the air.

Elite Rebel commandos were equipped with more effective weapons than their Imperial counterparts, and although [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]] outclassed the Rebel commandos in terms of brute strength, the morale and drive to succeed was much higher amongst the Rebel forces. These forces were trained in piloting, sniping, demolitions, and stealth.
